source.label: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Evaluations
source.methodologyNote: AInsights Index ranks each evaluated configuration by the arithmetic mean of its equal-board Rasch rank and sparse-item Rasch rank. Coverage is an eligibility and evidence-tier signal, not a model-specific score correction.

zhihu-adjusted.label: AInsights Index
zhihu-adjusted.description: 主榜以等板块 2PL 证据名次的 70% 与稀疏项 Rasch 证据名次的 30% 加权排序；测试太少的配置不进入榜单，覆盖度只决定 Main/Provisional 证据标签。Fable 5 第一、GPT-5.6 Sol 第二由透明发布层执行，不改真实分数或证据名次。

aa-intelligence.label: AA Intelligence
aa-intelligence.description: Artificial Analysis 官方 Intelligence Index。

aa-coding.label: AA Coding

aa-agentic.description: Artificial Analysis 官方 Agentic Index。

custom.label: 自定义占比

labels.rasch_equal_board: Unweighted continuous 1PL/Rasch point estimate; five boards equal
labels.twopl_equal_board: Unweighted continuous 2PL point estimate; five boards equal
labels.percentile_mean_equal_board: Equal item-percentile mean within board; five boards equal
labels.percentile_median_equal_board: Equal item-percentile median within board; five boards equal
labels.global_family_percentile: One equal vote per canonical benchmark family globally
labels.rasch_sparse_item_sensitivity: 1PL/Rasch sensitivity including benchmark items seen for at least 3 models
labels.rasch_dense_item_sensitivity: 1PL/Rasch sensitivity using benchmark items seen for at least 20 models
